sections.heading: Pick one. Pass the rest.
body: Keep one card. Pass the pack.
Packs usually move left, right, then left.
Good cards passed to you reveal open colors.
Your first pick is not a promise.

sections.heading: Answer their best card.
body: Games are often won based on who is able to interact more.

sections.heading: Build a 40-card deck.
body: Try 15 creatures and eight other spells.
Count removal inside those spell slots.
Adjust for your curve and plan.

sections.heading: Play before turn four.
body: Cheap plays keep you alive and attacking.
Too many expensive cards strand your hand.

sections.heading: Pick a plan.
body: Start with two colors. Branch when supported.

plans.name: Blink
plans.body: Reuse enter-the-battlefield abilities with exile-and-return effects.

plans.name: Counters + go wide
plans.body: Build wide, add counters, then attack.

plans.name: Artifact sacrifice
plans.body: Sacrifice artifacts for damage and value.

plans.name: Power 4+
plans.body: Reach four power early. Claim the rewards.

plans.name: Delirium
plans.body: Load varied card types into your graveyard.

plans.name: Humans
plans.body: Build a Human army. Attack early.

plans.name: Noncombat damage
plans.body: Chain small damage into lethal rewards.

plans.name: Theft
plans.body: Disrupt them. Win with their best cards.
